name: Turkish Steak Wrap with Arugula, Tomato, Cucumber & Olive Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a large plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp coriander
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook, flipping once, until desired doneness, 4-5 minutes for medium-rare. Transfer to a clean plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel, quarter, and thinly slice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, dill, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp dill
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Trim cucumbers, quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Halve olives and add to bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Return the grill pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches, place tortillas in the pan and warm, flipping occasionally, until lightly charred, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread evenly with yogurt. Divide steak and ⅓ of the salad between them; roll tightly to close and cut in half.
Divide wraps between plates; serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
